usageNotes: Use this to update cluster-wide firewall settings on a remote PVE cluster, such as enabling/disabling the firewall, changing default inbound/outbound/forward policies, or adjusting log rate-limiting. Requires `System.Modify` on the remote resource — API tokens are supported. Always fetch the current digest via the corresponding GET endpoint and pass it in the `digest` field to guard against concurrent modifications.

examples.summary: Enable the cluster firewall with DROP inbound/outbound defaults and conservative log rate-limiting

tips: Setting `enable` to 0 (the default) disables the cluster firewall entirely — this overrides all per-host and per-VM firewall rules on the remote cluster.
The `delete` array accepts option key names (e.g. `["policy_in", "log_ratelimit"]`) to reset them to their defaults rather than requiring you to know the default value.
Changing `policy_in` or `policy_out` to DROP without first confirming rule coverage can cut off management access to the remote cluster.
The endpoint returns null on success — absence of an error is the confirmation.
Log rate-limiting (`log_ratelimit`) is encoded as a comma-separated key=value string matching the typetext format: `enable=<1|0> [,burst=<integer>] [,rate=<string>]`.
